position_on: the key's own pole: protecting abortion access and reproductive freedom
confidence_reason: Two of his own campaign platform pages pledge federal legislation to codify Roe v. Wade and protect contraception and IVF; held at 0.85 because both sources are campaign pages from the same site and neither is dated more precisely than its last edit.
